_comment: Single source of truth for launch-gating switches. Read by both the app (src/lib/site.ts) and the node generators (scripts/*.mjs). Change values here and nowhere else.
_searchIndexingEnabled: THE NOINDEX SWITCH. false => every page emits <meta name="robots" content="noindex,follow"> and robots.txt serves Disallow: /. Flip to true when the first videos are public, then run `npm run build` and redeploy. Nothing else needs editing.
_customDomainLive: false while the site is only reachable at *.pages.dev. Flip to true ONLY after howweknowdeep.com is attached to the Pages project and resolving; it activates the www -> apex and pages.dev -> apex redirects in public/_redirects. Flipping it early makes the staging URL redirect to a domain that does not resolve yet.
_privacyContactEmail: Contact address published on /privacy and /terms for privacy questions, complaints and data-deletion requests. YouTube API Services Developer Policy III.A.2.i requires one, and the API audit form checks for it. Empty => both pages render an explicit 'not yet published' line and point at the Google security settings revocation route instead, and validate-legal-policy.mjs prints a NAMED STOP naming this key. The candidate is the Gmail that owns @howweknowdeep (the channel's own Google account), left unset because publishing an address is the owner's decision, not the build's. Set it here, rebuild, redeploy.
_webAnalyticsToken: Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon token. Cookieless, no consent banner required. Empty => beacon not emitted. Paste the token from Cloudflare dash > Web Analytics to activate.
